# `house_mailing_summary_values`

**House mailing summary values**

Typed numeric cells with explicit metric, unit, precision and blank-cell status.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicitly selected retained House report pages. Completion covers that page selection only. Other pages, historical image tables and unsupported layouts remain outside the qualified reading. *(measured 2026-11-06)*

**Data quality.** Preserve source occurrences, signed values, real zeros and blank cells. Components, totals, report periods and amended summary periods have different meanings. Do not sum overlapping metrics or combine repeated historical parts without a separately qualified source selection. These modern mailing and communications values describe total costs; legacy postage-only mass-mail tables require a separate reader.

- **Parquet file:** `house_mailing_summary_values.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
